notes: Only n_o assigned. Experiment 3 reports seventy-two participants and no exclusions, but does not explicitly report a critical-model analytic N or final group counts. The page-9 locator and broad description identify multiple possible tests: pass-response valence F(2, 70) = 28.23 and its within-pass contrasts; pleasant-response prime-valence main effect F(2, 134) = 91.37; Prime valence × Response option interaction F(2, 134) = 0.60; separate passing and no-passing effects F(2, 64) = 52.10 and F(2, 70) = 39.72. These have different sample scopes. The seventy-two participant statement is retained only as a candidate study-wide N; model-specific sample correspondence remains unresolved. No N was derived from df, no group counts were inferred, and no arithmetic was performed. PDF pages 8–9 (printed pp.382–383) visually inspected. Unassigned fields are placeholders.
